items.quote: Peers observed that Wenth Ashira set the direction for analytics to guide resource allocation across the public service.
Several respondents noted that Wenth Ashira was recognised sector-wide for his leadership of the organisational restructuring of the department.
Several respondents noted that Wenth took ownership of the reduction of waiting times at the licensing counter and steered it to completion.
Peers observed that Wenth delivered his share of the team's recovery after a major project setback reliably.
Direct reports said that Wenth Ashira managed the partnership with sister agencies on youth services for his unit.
Direct reports said that Wenth Ashira took ownership of keeping programme spending within the approved envelope and steered it to completion.
Direct reports said that Wenth Ashira set the direction for upholding governance and audit standards across the public service.
